performance.scope: 6 complete generated direct numeric range queries, both optimized profiles, three repetitions with alternating pair order. Workspace is tracked query memory; elapsed_ns is synthetic query timing, not Agent throughput or process RSS.

limitations: Finite inputs do not prove arbitrary-input equivalence.
Fixture timings and tracked query workspace are not production disk throughput or RSS.
Standalone foreign callers do not qualify a whole foreign Netdata Agent.
Caller ASan/UBSan does not instrument the Rust archive; MSRV is compile-only.
Generic multi-output, aggregation, unary and subquery head bookkeeping is intentionally retained.
Other uniqueness/final replay costs remain; this does not establish linear total preparation or fewer raw reads.
Earlier qualification cohorts preserve their actual source and binary identities.
